description: Run independent review, tests, QA, regression, and evidence gates.
exit_contract: independent evidence and pass, repair, blocked, or needs-input disposition

invalidate_on: source evidence becomes stale or fails verification

gates: select only atomic steps whose trigger matches and prerequisites are current
preserve candidate permission identity and mutation scope exactly
remote, local-system, external-session, and local-git steps remain disabled without fresh current authorization
hard dependencies are current-run prerequisites; optional dependencies never force activation; feedback dependencies feed a future pass and never block current-run execution
no passed handoff without complete four-part evidence contract
human_checkpoint: human accepts independent findings, risk disposition, and any separate repair authorization

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Run and compare a frozen baseline and candidate check set under matched conditions, attribute regressions, and preserve current evidence without source repair.
hard_gates: A regression verdict requires frozen identities and matched commands, environment, data, seeds, warmup, thresholds, and retry policy; unmatched or stale evidence is incomparable, not passing.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A trusted historical baseline and a current measurement made under the same contract.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Acquire authorized repository and provider-read evidence for a code review, bind it to exact refs, and stop before issuing findings or comments.
hard_gates: Review evidence is valid only when bound to exact base/head refs and provider identity; acquisition authority never includes findings, comments, labels, source edits, or remote writes.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Change identity, base and head refs, approved provider read access, review scope, and untrusted-content boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Verify a completion claim from current reproducible commands, exits, durations, source identity, artifacts, hashes, and declared limitations without changing the work.
hard_gates: A completion claim cannot pass from prose, status text, model confidence, stale output, or partial success; each required criterion needs current target-bound executable or artifact evidence.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A proposed status claim and the command capable of proving it.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Execute an authorized developer journey and measure time-to-first-success, setup, errors, documentation, compatibility, and recovery without changing product source.
hard_gates: Developer experience claims require a real target-bound journey with recorded environment, commands, elapsed time, errors, recovery, and cleanup; reading docs alone is insufficient.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Repository, runnable setup path, common tasks, errors, timings, and contributor context.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Independently compare an implementation and its evidence with frozen requirements, design, interfaces, and scope without editing source.
hard_gates: Compliance passes only when every frozen requirement and design obligation has current implementation and verification evidence and no unapproved behavior is silently introduced.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Approved task requirements, implementation diff, source snapshot, and implementer report as an untrusted claim.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Independently exercise a built product through public user surfaces, record reproducible findings and evidence, and never inspect or repair source.
hard_gates: Black-box QA must use public product surfaces and current build evidence; source inspection, implementation knowledge, or self-repair invalidates reviewer independence.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: An accessible application, change scope, QA mode, and authorized interaction boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Independently inspect a ref-bound code change for correctness, security, failure handling, compatibility, tests, and maintainability without editing it.
hard_gates: A finding requires a concrete failing or risky scenario, source citation, consequence, and contract; the reviewer never edits source, posts comments, or approves its own remediation.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A specification, change description, and precise code-diff boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Implement bounded local or draft-online evaluator definitions and calibration checks against an explicit quality contract; provider activation remains separate.
hard_gates: An evaluator cannot pass from plausible rubric prose: it needs versioned executable behavior, labeled calibration cases, abstention and invalid handling, disagreement evidence, and no unauthorized provider call.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Quality target, classified traces, evaluator mode, judge policy, local workspace, and data-governance boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Evaluate supplied model outputs with governed deterministic metrics, factuality checks, calibrated judges, human agreement, statistics, and regression comparisons without provider activation.
hard_gates: External LLM Judge use is not implicit in local evaluation authority; without explicit data-transfer, provider, retention, deletion, and cost authorization, judge-dependent results remain blocked.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Model outputs, references, criteria, annotations, and trusted historical baselines.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Benchmark supplied model or workflow variants on frozen cases, matched environments, metrics, variance, cost, latency, and evidence without remote submission or product approval.
hard_gates: A benchmark requires frozen cases and versions, matched environment and budgets, warmup, repeated runs, variance, failed-case retention, and exact artifacts; leaderboard point estimates alone fail.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Frozen cases, candidate variants, metric contract, environment, and budget.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Design Playwright test source as a candidate artifact and execute or diagnose authorized existing Playwright tests without writing project source.
hard_gates: A local-exec Playwright candidate cannot modify project tests or config; project installation or source writes require a separate authorized workspace capability.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Browser behaviors, test environments, risks, data, and automation acceptance goals.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Triage independently observed QA findings by reproducibility, severity, duplication, scope, ownership, and next capability without source repair.
hard_gates: Triage may classify and route findings but cannot repair source, waive risk, close defects without current evidence, or overwrite independent severity ownership.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: QA findings, evidence, affected surface, release context, and severity policy.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Run a bounded unauthenticated or already-authorized browser probe for one declared question and capture non-destructive evidence without source or session mutation.
hard_gates: A safe probe has one declared question, allowlisted origins and actions, no credential or destructive state change, and complete capture provenance and cleanup.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A target page, authorized interactions, and a ready browser runtime.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Derive traceable executable test cases, risk priority, data needs, coverage gaps, and one consumer-specific export from approved requirements without implementing tests.
hard_gates: Every test case must trace to approved behavior or risk and state preconditions, data, action, observable expected result, priority, and test level; exported volume cannot substitute for coverage quality.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Approved requirements, risk profile, platform, test level, data constraints, and downstream format.
outputs: five-dimension case quality score in the coverage matrix

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Assess or design the smallest behavior-focused test double boundary so tests use complete data shapes and do not pollute production interfaces.
hard_gates: A double is justified only at a real owned boundary and must preserve complete contract shapes and meaningful failures; mocking internals or adding test-only production APIs fails.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A test design that requires dependency isolation or an existing test double.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Design a risk-based portfolio of static, unit, integration, contract, browser, performance, accessibility, security, and manual checks with ownership and feedback goals.
hard_gates: A portfolio must justify every layer by observable risk and feedback value; test-count targets, pyramid dogma, and duplicate assertions across layers are not strategy.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: System architecture, risks, component types, environments, and data constraints.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Design Vitest test or configuration source as a candidate artifact and execute or diagnose authorized existing Vitest tests without writing project source.
hard_gates: A local-exec Vitest candidate cannot modify project tests or config; project installation or source writes require a separate authorized workspace capability.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A JavaScript or TypeScript unit or integration test project using Vitest.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Independently assess an authorized website using local and read-only external evidence across content, accessibility, SEO, performance, security signals, links, and behavior without remediation.
hard_gates: Assessment authority is read-only: no source repair, form submission with consequential state, account change, provider mutation, deployment, or finding closure is permitted.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A scannable site, audit CLI, permitted external read scope, and optional frozen baseline.
